The local chord-analysis bundle contains:

- Spotify Basic Pitch TypeScript 1.0.1 and its model weights
  https://github.com/spotify/basic-pitch-ts
  Copyright Spotify AB
  Licensed under the Apache License 2.0. The complete license text is in
  BASIC_PITCH_LICENSE.txt.

- TensorFlow.js 3.21.0
  https://github.com/tensorflow/tfjs
  Copyright 2018 Google LLC
  Licensed under the Apache License 2.0. The complete license text is in
  BASIC_PITCH_LICENSE.txt.
